subject: Mutual action plan — stakeholders, milestones & target dates (ODN-3742)
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@odin.tech>, procurement@odin.tech
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan — initial milestones & stakeholders (ODN-3742)

Hi Marta / Odin team,

Thanks again for the call today — great context and very helpful prioritization on the real-time content filtration use case. Below is my read of the main goals, risks, and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) we can iterate on. I attached a simple XLSX with the timeline so your procurement and security folks can comment directly.

High-level goals we heard:
- Reduce inference tail latency for short queries (target p95 < 120ms)
- Lower per-request token cost for production traffic via batching/caching
- Meet corporate security / data residency controls for EU customers on launch

Key risks / blockers you called out:
- Procurement sign-off + SOW approval cadence (Procurement lead: unknown)
- Security evidence for KMS integration and audit logs (SOC 2 artifacts requested)
- A short production pilot (10k monthly sessions) to validate latency & cost numbers

Proposed mutual action plan (please confirm owners/dates):
1) Pilot SOW draft & pricing — Redwood to send draft (Milestone: SOW sent) — target: 2026-12-06 — Owner: Mateo (Redwood)
2) Security questionnaire + evidence share — Odin to confirm required artifacts, Redwood to respond (Milestone: Security Qs answered) — target: 2026-12-09 — Owner: Security (Odin) / Mateo 
3) Pilot readiness checklist & infra runbook — Redwood to provide config & runbook (Milestone: Pilot ready) — target: 2026-12-20 — Owner: Ben (Redwood)
4) Pilot start — 2-week canary + monitoring (Milestone: Pilot live) — target: 2027-01-08 — Owner: Odin engineering / Redwood ops
5) Decision + commercial close — Odin exec sponsor sign-off & DocuSign (Milestone: Contract signed) — target: 2027-01-22 — Owner: Procurement (Odin) / Lauren (Redwood)

Attachments: ODIN_MPA_v1.xlsx (timeline + roles), Security_Qs_Response.pdf (initial security notes) — see attached.

Ask: Can you confirm the internal Odin stakeholders for procurement, engineering sponsor, and security, and whether the dates above look reasonable? Once we align I’ll update the XLSX and issue the SOW draft.

Thanks,

Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Mateo,

Appreciate the clear summary — that tracks closely with our conversation. A few clarifications from our side:

- Procurement contact: I’ve looped in procurement@odin.tech (Sam is our CTO and will be an exec sponsor; procurement will handle signature after pricing alignment).
- Security lead: Priya Singh (priya.singh@odin.tech) will own the SOC2 / KMS review — I’ll introduce her separately to your security team.
- Timeline tweak: Can we move the SOW send date to 2026-12-08? Our finance lead is on travel next week and we want a 5-business-day review window.

We also want a short appendix listing data residency controls we’ll need for EU customers — can Redwood add that to the Security_Qs_Response.pdf?

Next steps for us: procurement will confirm legal terms once we see the SOW. We’d like a one-hour technical onboarding for the pilot runbook (suggested window: week of Dec 13).

Happy to sync if needed — thanks,

Marta Ruiz
Head of Product Ops | Odin Tech
Marta.Ruiz@odin.tech

Adding a few operational notes for the pilot and security ask:

- Pilot scope: We should define a small test partition (sampled traffic ~10k sessions/month) so we can measure p95 and cost under representative load. Recommend a 2-week canary, then scale to full pilot.
- Runbook & observability: I will draft a concise runbook (deployment steps, failover policy, KB for integrations) and share by 2026-12-15.
- Security artifacts: We can provide the KMS integration guide and audit log examples; I’ll attach a short stub. If Priya needs SOC2 artifacts we can coordinate with our security lead to produce a permissions matrix.

Action for Mateo: please confirm SOW send date change to 2026-12-08 and if so I’ll prioritize the runbook timeline accordingly.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
